verdict.rationale: Sentry ingests OTel traces and logs via OTLP alongside its native error/issue and performance data, and Seer Agent claims to find the right telemetry to answer questions, suggesting cross-signal pivoting within one platform. However, evidence doesn't show a unified metrics product (Sentry deprecated its metrics beta historically) or detailed docs on shared context/correlation UI across logs-traces-errors-metrics simultaneously. missing for 10: explicit metrics product documentation, concrete UI walkthrough of pivoting between logs/traces/metrics with shared trace/span context, independent SRE hands-on validation of cross-signal correlation.
